notes.title: Nominate Us and shake some drinks together
notes.content: Maybe we are a bit rusty, but still, we got it :)

notes.title: Important bug fixed
notes.content:
Due to the fact that we are currently preparing the PSVR version, we moved the game to the most up-to-date version of the EU4, removing minor errors and introducing better performance, so that the playing comfort would be as great as possible. We did not notice the most obvious mistake and we published build with a bug. 

The issue was: 

- while having completed all of challenge modes and then having improved user's result, the following bars became disabled once again. This issue has been totally fixed and now you can enjoy Bartender VR completely trying to improve your bartender skills. 

Now we are working on other minor issues and soon we will update the game one again so that you can fully enjoy it. What's more, we are preparing the additional drinks. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Bartender VR Released
notes.content:
It is time to move from Early Access. We successfully implemented Leaderboard and thanks to that you are able to compete with each other.
We got a lot of feedback and requests for some playground, where you can do everything you want - so we added a new mode Free Mode with a possibility to discover 30 drinks.

We would like to thank everyone who supported us during Early Access period. Your suggestions were crucial in making Bartender VR Simulator even better. Thank you!

notes.title: Free Mode + New Drinks!
notes.content:
We prepared for you special mode where you can do anything you want! We present Free Mode!

There is something more... a discovery system. In free mode, you are able to create your drink and check what you have made by putting it on the napkin.

We added 12 new drinks! All of them are available in free mode.

notes.title: Force Feedback and fridge doors
notes.content:
We implemented force feedback for all Oculus Rift users! Also, we added few new ones for Vive. In this matter, I would like to thank our community member [b]escetic[/b] for the great and detailed suggestion!

From now on you are also able to close fridge doors without gripping it, simply push it to close.

notes.title: Small improvements
notes.content:
We are working hard to make Bartender VR even better. Here are some improvements we made in current patch:

- Increased volume of crushed ice
- Adjusted angle on which the liquid is poured out
- Fixed a bug with putting down ingredients
- Changed logic of single drink unlock system
- Change speed of selecting buttons in handy menu

notes.title: Leaderboard is live! + some other updates
notes.content:
Yes, the leaderboard is live! From now on you can compare your scores with other players from around the world! (You can find it in Profile)

While competing in challenge mode your score is essential. But you can also compete in single drink category - try to reach a top score for each drink in the shortest time!

About other things that we improved:
- Gameplay: Mixing color formula for substance in glass
- Gameplay: Pouring out from glasses
- Gameplay: Ice cubes Volume.
- Gameplay: Ice cubes split angle
- Gameplay/UI: Recenter button in handy menu

notes.title: Leaderboard and save system announcement
notes.content:
Leaderboard will be published on Wednesday (22.11.2017). 
We are also improving save system. So if you want to transfer your save file here is a quick guide how to do this:

Copy a file Slot0.sav from: Steam\steamapps\common\Bartender VR Simulator\BartenderVR\Saved\SaveGames
into:
<OS Drive>:\Users\<User Name>\AppData\Local\BartenderVR\Saved\SaveGames
If the directory is not present, create it.

About additional changes, we will inform you in the next news

notes.title: Leaderboard server is ready
notes.content:
We would like to inform you that leaderboard server is on! From now on we will be gathering all data about your scores.
Visual representation is almost ready and we plan to make it accessible at the start of the next week.

For those who already played, you can just log in - your scores will be automatically sent to us. If you want to beat your personal records then it is the best time to do this.

Good luck!
